title: Smart building monitoring with edge gateways and a cloud dashboard
user_prompt: We sell an energy-monitoring solution for office buildings. In each building we install one gateway box (a small Linux computer) and around 40 wireless sensors for temperature, presence and electricity. The sensors report to the gateway every minute, the gateway aggregates and sends a telemetry batch to our cloud every 10 minutes, and keeps a local buffer in case the connection drops. We currently have about 1,500 buildings equipped, mostly in France, and we add roughly 60 buildings per month. Facility managers log into a web dashboard (maybe 3,000 users, a few times a week) to look at charts, and once a month we generate PDF reports for every building. The cloud side ingests telemetry into a time-series database and serves the dashboard. I'd like to understand what weighs most: the hardware we deploy, the telemetry traffic, or the cloud.

facts_if_asked.gateway: ARM board, 4 cores, 4 GB RAM, 32 GB flash, about 6 W, 5-year expected life.
facts_if_asked.sensors: Battery-powered, about 0.05 W average, 30 g electronics, 7-year life.
facts_if_asked.telemetry: Each 10-minute batch is about 20 kB; ingestion writes it to the time-series DB.
facts_if_asked.reports: 1 PDF per building per month, around 20 s of CPU each.

expected_properties: An edge deployment with new_devices about 60 per month and existing_devices about 1,500 (gateways) and 60,000 (sensors), country FRANCE, and a usage span of several years.
A gateway edge device of kind computer, and a sensor edge device of kind appliance (or an explicit assumption folding sensors into the gateway).
An edge function on the gateway with server_calls to a telemetry ingestion job at 6 times per hour.
The ingestion job on a time-series DB server; the dashboard journey reads from the same server or a dedicated API server that reads it; no duplicate DB.
A dashboard journey with a usage pattern of a few thousand users a few times a week, on laptop.
A monthly report batch journey with a low-volume usage pattern (about 1,500 per month) and a CPU-heavy job.
No end-user device modeled as an edge device.
